title: McLaren and Williams eye Baku boost as every team's upgrades are revealed
extract: McLaren has brought a broad package of aerodynamic changes to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, while the official F1 technical roundup details the upgrades introduced across the field.

title: BMW M3 Electric prototype shows its tail-happy side at the Nürburgring
extract: BMW's first electric M3 is undergoing Nürburgring testing with four motors, a selectable rear-wheel-drive mode and a projected output of around 800 horsepower.

title: Aston Martin DB4 Series III sells for £370,800 at Bonhams Revival
extract: A restored 1961 Aston Martin DB4 Series III sold for £370,800 at the Goodwood Revival collectors' auction, with matching numbers and extensive specialist restoration records.

title: Macau opens hypercar exhibition featuring Ferrari F40, F50 and Aston Martin Valhalla
extract: Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace have opened a public exhibition of more than 20 rare hypercars spanning six decades, including multiple Ferraris, an Aston Martin Valhalla and a Pagani Huayra R.

title: Mercedes-AMG GT3 Evo selected for 2027 Spa 24 Hours academy programme
extract: Motopark will run a Mercedes-AMG GT3 Evo for a fully funded 2027 Spa 24 Hours entry made up of drivers graduating from the SRO GT Academy.

title: BMW 7 Series appears alongside futuristic art installation in Istanbul
extract: BMW is showcasing the new 7 Series alongside A.A.Murakami's SYMBIOSIS installation in Istanbul, linking the car's design language to the company's Neue Klasse technology vision.

title: A classical-computing attack weakens RSA without factoring the key
extract: Researchers have demonstrated a new classical-computing technique that can forge RSA signatures without factoring the underlying key, sharply reducing the security margin of textbook RSA implementations.

title: Node.js 22.23.3 LTS fixes HTTP/2 use-after-free vulnerability
extract: Node.js 22.23.3 closes a heap use-after-free flaw in its HTTP/2 stack that could crash servers or potentially enable remote code execution, while adding new Node-API functions.

title: SparkyLinux 2026.09 ships with Linux 7.2 and a new Labwc edition
extract: SparkyLinux 2026.09 updates its Debian Testing base and Linux kernel while adding its first official Labwc Wayland edition for users seeking a lightweight desktop environment.

title: System76 COSMIC Epoch 1.9.0 adds on-screen keyboard and cosmic-viewer
extract: The latest COSMIC desktop release adds an on-screen keyboard and the cosmic-viewer application as System76 continues developing its Rust-based Linux desktop environment.

title: Meta expands Muse AI across new wearable hardware
extract: Meta has expanded its Muse AI agent strategy with new smart glasses, camera-free audio glasses and a standalone Charm device intended to make the agent available without a phone.

title: git-bug 0.11 gives its distributed bug tracker a full web UI
extract: The open-source git-bug project has released version 0.11 with a redesigned web interface, code browsing, GraphQL improvements and new packages for its offline-first issue tracker.

title: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection launches with a deep Amiga archive
extract: The six first-era Alien Breed games have returned on modern platforms with updated controls, new Horde and Rush modes and a virtual museum containing development material and cancelled-project documentation.

title: Risky Woods arrives on Amstrad PCW
extract: A new port brings Dinamic Software's 16-bit action game Risky Woods to the Amstrad PCW, supporting joystick input, DK Sound audio and a 12-level campaign.

title: Flashback gets a work-in-progress Sega Master System port
extract: A new homebrew project is porting Delphine Software's 1992 cinematic platformer Flashback from its original MS-DOS and Amiga-era roots to the Sega Master System.

title: Majora's Mask PC port arrives through Ship of Harkinian project
extract: A fan-made PC port brings The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask to modern computers through the Ship of Harkinian project, continuing the community's work on native modern ports of classic games.

title: Super Mario Galaxy decompilation project gets a new commit
extract: The Petari community decompilation project for Super Mario Galaxy received a new update, part of continuing efforts to reconstruct classic Nintendo software from its original binaries.

title: A 3v3 68010 project combines classic Motorola silicon with FPGA glue logic
extract: A hobbyist has built a 68010-based computer around modern 3.3V logic, level shifting and an FPGA handling bus decode and glue logic, with zero-wait-state RAM reads.

title: Amiga Unix gets a modern community revival for 68040 and 68060 systems
extract: The AmigaUX community project is modernising Commodore's obscure Amiga Unix port with support for later Motorola processors, modern build tools, a package manager and updated networking software.

title: Stargate gets a machine-language VIC-20 homebrew recreation
extract: A community developer has recreated Williams' Stargate for the Commodore VIC-20 in pure machine language, building a fast arcade-style shooter specifically around the hardware's constraints.

title: Zeewolf and Zeewolf 2 are getting an ultrawide PC modernization
extract: Almost There Games is modernising the Amiga classics Zeewolf and Zeewolf 2 for PC with widescreen support and high-resolution improvements while retaining the original games' core gameplay.

title: The A1200 full-size Amiga replica returns to pre-order
extract: Retro Games has reopened pre-orders for its full-size working Amiga 1200 replica, with an original-scale case and keyboard and a December 2026 release target.

title: U2 announce new album Carnaval de Luz with Dolly Parton and Rosalía
extract: U2 have announced Carnaval de Luz, their first proper new studio album in almost nine years, and shared the single Silencio ahead of the band's 50th anniversary.

title: Sebadoh announce expanded 30th-anniversary edition of Harmacy
extract: Sebadoh are celebrating Harmacy with an expanded anniversary edition containing alternate takes, rare B-sides, BBC sessions and live recordings, alongside an alternate version of Beauty Of The Ride.

title: The War On Drugs debut new song Now We're Talkin' live
extract: The War On Drugs debuted a previously unheard song, Now We're Talkin', during a Birmingham show as the band continues its current run of live dates.

title: Morphine announce posthumous album Cocoon with Mark Sandman recordings
extract: A new posthumous Morphine album will collect recordings made by Mark Sandman before his death, more than a quarter century after the band's final album featuring him.

title: Blithe Field announces Soft Core Hard Wear
extract: Spencer Radcliffe's Blithe Field project has announced a new album assembled from synthesizers, samplers and cassette tapes, previewed by the strange single Milked Rainbow.

title: Bonniesongs returns with new single Scream
extract: Bonniesongs has released Scream, an off-kilter grunge-influenced single built around flexible vocals, grumbling guitar, piano, toy percussion and increasingly chaotic textures.

title: Vacheron Constantin celebrates the Overseas collection's 30th anniversary
extract: Vacheron Constantin has introduced a 200-piece Overseas Perpetual Calendar Ultra-Thin limited edition with an 18K white-gold case and new azure dial for the collection's 30th anniversary.

title: Héron launches the Continental collection
extract: Montreal-based Héron has introduced the Continental, a three-watch vintage-inspired sports collection drawing on visual cues from classic Rolex Explorer, Omega Railmaster and Universal Genève designs.

title: Glashütte Original Senator Chronograph gets two new configurations
extract: Glashütte Original has presented two new Senator Chronograph variants, one with a finely grained silver dial and another Navigator version with a matte black pilot-style dial.

title: WatchTime highlights standout watches heading to New York
extract: WatchTime previews notable watches due at WatchTime New York 2026, including new pieces from independent and established makers such as MB&F, Daniel Roth, Gérald Genta and Zenith.

title: Exit Party by Emily St John Mandel explores two possible futures
extract: Emily St John Mandel's new science-fiction novel follows a woman moving between two radically different post-crisis Americas, contrasting social stability with pervasive surveillance.

title: The Rouse blends Cold War espionage with the supernatural
extract: China Miéville's huge new speculative novel combines a 1970s London family tragedy with military intrigue, paranormal investigations and an expansive alternate history.

title: The Complex by Karan Mahajan reviewed as an ambitious family saga
extract: Karan Mahajan's new novel The Complex explores family, politics and modern Delhi through a large-scale literary narrative that appeared among the Guardian's September fiction reviews.

title: Heresy brings psychedelic folk horror to UK digital release
extract: The upcoming folk-horror film Heresy follows a woman isolated in a village where strange events, religious fear and accusations of witchcraft begin to close around her.

title: The Nice Ones heads for UK cinemas with a sinister countryside mystery
extract: The Nice Ones is a new folk-horror film built around mysterious lights, strained friendships and an apparently sinister force, with a UK cinema release scheduled for November.

title: New York Comic Con reveals a Star Trek: Starfleet Academy Season 2 first look
extract: TV Insider's 2026 New York Comic Con schedule includes a first look at Star Trek: Starfleet Academy Season 2 alongside panels for Blade Runner 2099, Percy Jackson and other genre properties.

title: Backrooms and Unabomber arrive on streaming this week
extract: CinemaBlend's current streaming update notes Backrooms arriving on HBO Max and Unabomber on Netflix on September 25, alongside other recent genre and mainstream releases.
